title: Wife's matching dream of number cubes at Schwandorf church

tellings.quote: and as I came approached the end, dim light, just some lights on the church on the side, I saw your desk.

plain: In 1978, in the German town of Schwandorf, the wife of the former CIA officer Rolf Mowatt-Larssen is said to have had a dream that matched his own dream of cubes with numbers on them at a church. Mowatt-Larssen repeats what she told him: as she got near the end of the dream, in dim light, with only a few lights on the side of the church, "I saw your desk." He tells it as a sign that the two of them shared the same vision, part of his larger story of seeing across time.
